title: fix(ui): Usage filters change when Enter confirms IME input
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes Usage filters changing or search focus leaving the input when Enter confirms IME composition. Confirming a provider search can select the first match and silently narrow the displayed usage; a creator picker can select a person and close.

## User Impact

Users can confirm composed text while retaining the search, focus and current filters. A following ordinary Enter still selects the first search result. No configuration or migration is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the existing input-local IME helper in the shared value picker, including keyCode 229 and Enter immediately after compositionend. For composition-confirming Enter, stop propagation to the parent menu without preventing the browser default. Clear composition tracking on key-up and blur, as the neighboring query search already does. The shared change covers both multi-value filters and the single-choice creator picker.

Related: #195087, an external-contributor Usage query IME fix merged by @obviyus on November 8. That fix covered the query field; this fixes the separate value-search handler.

## Evidence

Verified candidate: `47acf54bb48cd98a6246c35b29575a51bbb449a6`.

[Real-Gateway browser proof, request counts and sanitized before/after screenshots](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/199872#issuecomment-6905516379). Two baseline and two candidate runs in Chromium exercise provider and creator pickers with trusted CDP IME events. Both confirmation variants accidentally select on baseline; neither selects or sends a usage request on the candidate. Active-composition Enter, deliberate Enter exactly once, Escape and outside-close controls are retained. This reproduces WebKit's post-composition ordering in Chromium, not a physical OS IME or a WebKit-engine run.

- Focused tests: 28/28 pass; both extended regressions fail on baseline. Matching UI-pages test types and production UI types pass. Focused wall time: 2.49 seconds; CI timing is recorded on this head's checks.
- Full ocx build with declarations and packed CLI/UI smoke pass.
- Official CI-normalized gzip: startup JS 91092 → 91092 B; chat-boot JS 1314555 → 1314555 B; startup + chat JS/CSS total growth **0 B**.
- Production +16/-1; tests +52/-52, net 0. All 28 cases and original assertions remain; reactive fixture forwarding and repeated lookups were consolidated. No allocation file or product-message changes.

Original fix and parent-menu repair by @zhangguiping-xydt; both contributor commits are retained.

Merge risk: two-way door. Reverting restores the old key handling without changing persisted data or configuration. Blast radius is the shared Usage value-picker search, including provider filters and the single-choice creator picker.
